description: Hand-labeled composition classes for the CSL calibration dataset. Add one entry per photo placed in this folder. Photos are NOT committed to git (see data/seed_photos/.gitignore) — keep your local files matching the relative_path field. Re-run scripts/calibrate_composition_thresholds.py after every label change.

labels.notes: Tight head crop, shoulders not visible (Telegram avatar).
Head to waist, no legs visible (cafe scene).
Full body, head to feet (beach scene).
